displayName: Website Crawler API - Map, Crawl and Batch Extract to Markdown
description: Crawl a whole website to clean Markdown, map every URL from its sitemap, or batch extract up to 1,000 URLs in one job. Crawl and batch run as jobs with a status URL or a signed webhook; map is 1 credit; each successful page is 1 credit (2 on ultra), failed pages are free. Robots.txt obeyed.
